out_of_sample: 2020-10-01 .. 2026-11-11 (25 folds); loop rules A/B and comparisons with them to 2025-11-11 only

verdict.text: NO. Out of sample (Oct 2020 - Nov 2026, BTC, the headline), the Phase 4 primary agent (Q agent, BTC+ETH pooled, expanding, readings) shows an edge before costs on every seed (gross Sharpe 0.84, 0.65, 0.84, mean 0.78, t about 1.9; break-even fee 0.302%, 0.290%, 0.302%). After 0.10% fees it does not beat buy-and-hold and momentum risk-adjusted across seeds: seed-mean Sharpe 0.48 (seeds above buy-and-hold's 0.64: 0 of 3; above momentum's 0.63: 0 of 3), Calmar 0.24 vs 0.29 and 0.34, net return +79%. None of the 8 Phase 4 variants beats both on every seed.

freeze.11 Nov 2026, ~19:45 UTC: this file drafted with every value (assets, pools, inputs, both families, all eight variants, the validation choices, the 'do no harm' bar, the verdict rules, the learnability sizes and criteria, the primary rule) before any Phase 4 code ran on any data
freeze.11 Nov 2026, ~19:50 UTC: look-ahead check on real data (inputs only, no model): the truncation tests were clean from the start; a first 'store == code' comparison for metals / energy recomputed the readings on each market's own bars instead of its group's common bars (as the store does) and was fixed in the checking code; rerun CLEAN for all 8 markets
freeze.11 Nov 2026, ~19:52 UTC: learnability run 1 (seed base 5000, draft SP design: penalty chosen by validation IC, with an intercept) STOPPED after 7 rows: IC is blind to prediction scale and picked the heaviest penalty (alpha 10), whose predictions never cleared the cost band (pool2_6y SP did not trade even in its training slice). Rows kept in phase4_learnability_run1_draft.partial.jsonl. Q results so far: neutral fallback in every fold (unchanged agent)
freeze.11 Nov 2026, ~20:00-20:10 UTC (synthetic: SP exploration (phase4_exploration_sp*.json): selection by validation R2 vs IC, 'do no harm' bar 0.5 / 0 / none, intercept on / off, at p3_9m and pool2_6y, 3-5 seeds. Chosen: select_on val_r2 (scale-aware, fixes run 1's failure; IC vs R2 test Sharpe differences within noise), intercept off (a timing agent should not carry a constant drift bet; little difference on synthetic data), 'do no harm' bar kept at Phase 3's 0.5. Seen there and left as is: without an edge the pooled model still bets on spurious slow trends in some seeds (exposure ~50%, test Sharpe ~-1), a limit of what 6 years of 15m data can tell apart. No Q setting changed. The frozen learnability check then runs on fresh series (seed base 7000)
freeze.11 Nov 2026, ~20:05-20:30 UTC: learnability check (main, 5 seeds, seed base 7000): at Phase 3's size (p3_9m) both families FAIL (planted edge found in 2 of 5 seeds by SP, 0 of 5 by Q); at single_3y both FAIL; at pool2_6y both PASS (edge found in 5 of 5 seeds; test Sharpe SP 1.72, Q 2.13 vs oracle 1.90; near flat without an edge). Primary by the rule: q_pool2_full. The power check (10 seeds, 24-month test) was still running and is reported as found; it decides nothing
freeze.11 Nov 2026, 20:30 UTC: everything frozen (status: frozen, primary q_pool2_full); then the walk-forward runs once
